annotations.title: Free check of a UK car

description:
The site's free check: identity, tax and MOT status, latest MOT test, its defects and recorded mileage,
    the existing since-previous-test summary and mileage-unverified flag. Includes presentation, up to three
    questions from these free facts, a verdict image, locked teasers and a report link. No account or credit needed.
    Show the returned markdown field as-is to the user.
    Next-MOT estimates, repair prices, mileage analysis and older MOT details require the detailed report.
